verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at supabase.com/llms.txt that links to a single-file full documentation dump. Docs pages are served as .md variants (e.g., ai-skills.md, plugins.md), and a keyless probe found a machine-discoverable agent-skills catalog at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json, backed by Agent Skills documentation. Missing for 10: no independent or community corroboration of agents actually using llms.txt or the skills, and the root /docs.md endpoint returns 404.
